title: How Turning Off Autoplay Gives a Godly Man His Evenings Back
caption:
You sat down for one episode. You looked up and it was 1 AM.

You didn't choose that. Autoplay did, five seconds at a time.

Turn it off. Every app. Tonight. Then every next episode becomes a decision instead of a default, and most nights you'll choose to stop.

Two hours a night is fourteen hours a week. That's time God gave you to steward, not stream.

"Making the best use of the time, because the days are evil." Ephesians 5:16

Save this. Go change the setting before you forget.
